name: Cael
title: Brother
role: A young adept of the Order of Ilun
note: A young Ilari adept sent out to find survivors of the Order, and much too honest for the job.
appearance: Thin and quick-moving, with skin patterns that flicker constantly and give away everything he feels.
personality: Earnest, funny and hopeful, which is rare these days. He's a very bad liar, and he knows it.
voice: Warm and tumbling, with a lot of half-finished sentences. Laughs at the wrong moments.
goals: Find the rest of the Order's lost novices, and work out what the song means.
secrets: He can hear the Choir's song too, and sometimes, when he's alone, he answers it. He hasn't told the Abbess.
